verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites (fly-io-docs-4, docs-5, docs-6) can run agents/MCP servers persistently, checkpoint, sleep and wake, which provides infrastructure for autonomous background workloads, but this is aimed at hosting agent runtimes rather than a built-in automation/scheduling system. A community review explicitly flags the lack of native scheduled/cron-like automation on the platform (fly-io-comm-20), meaning users must build their own scheduler app rather than get a first-party automation trigger. missing for 10: native cron/scheduling primitives, first-party trigger/orchestration docs for autonomous automations, hands-on evidence of background automations running successfully.
